Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The new text agrees with the code in `bore_reach.rs` and `bore_core.rs`. It states the concentric ring plan, the 4096-ring limit, and the refusal for a zero or too-small floor band. If all holes are skipped, the named error occurs before the command stores changes.

Local checks used PR head `561df9abc61e1b963ac48cc6e018bb063feacc23` and upstream main `6f8b309dcea9ea2c367ecfa53261ed140881bab3`. The trial merge returned “Already up to date.” Main is already an ancestor of this head.

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; zero test steps.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; zero steps and zero failures.
- Temporary documentation check: the old row failed; the new row passed all six assertions. The check covered rings, the ring limit, the floor band, the named refusal, no stored changes, and removal of the old width formula. This check did not change tracked files.

This PR changes documentation only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. Safety mutations are not applicable. No goldens or UI files changed. Runtime tests and crate clippy did not run because no Rust crate changed. No GitHub runner was used.

The body includes `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none (docs only)`, and `Fixes #1910`. The decision file records the choice and its reason. `PROCESS_VERSION` is unchanged.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
